SELECT
  MAX(subq_12.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
  , MAX(subq_19.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_19.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_19.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_19.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(1) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_12
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN member_id END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_sequence" order_sequence_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_19
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_26

统计范围：当前客户青禾的数据范围内，按2026年8月查询窗口（2026-08-01至2026-09-01）汇总，未按门店或地区拆分。人数口径为CRM会员账户数，不等于跨系统自然人；订单数按订单笔数；金额由分换算为元。

- 注册会员数：0 个账户。该窗口内按注册日期统计为0，属于覆盖范围内的零，不是未定义。
- 观测期首购会员数：5 个账户。口径为在全覆盖历史中确定首次有效订单，且首次订单落在该窗口的账户数，不代表终身首购。
- 观测期首单净销售额：12,800 分，即 128.00 元；为首单净额（实付减退款）汇总。
- 观测期首单数：5 单；每账户至多一单。
- 观测期后续购买订单数：22 单；为第二笔及以后有效订单落入窗口的订单数，不是复购人数。
- 有效订单数：27 单；口径为已支付且实付减退款大于零，取消和全退不计。首单5单与后续22单合计27单，与有效订单数一致。
